name: Lucky Crane
description: Paper cranes, a paper folding craft, are a symbol of good wishes. Legend has it that if you fold a paper crane a day and stick to it for a thousand days, you can bring happiness to the person you like, make them have good luck and make their dreams come true. The paper crane is often regarded as the patron saint of love. Carrying the paper crane as a gift from your lover means that you will not marry anyone who is not your king, and you will not marry anyone who is not your queen, and you will remain committed to your life.
